notes:
BUILD 26
- Stronger armour: Heavy Plate Helmet, Jacket and Pants (bench 3; the jacket and pants slow you a little), and a Plate Suit that goes in the suit slot OVER your other clothes for another 25%. Armour now caps at 85%.
- More gear: Road Sign Kilt, Combat Boots, a Large Backpack (+24 slots) and a Jetpack (back slot: hold SPACE in the air to burn low grade and climb).
- Explosive 5.56: fits anything that takes 5.56. 40% more damage, bursts on impact for 40% splash within two metres, and blast and vault doors take 75% of the round's damage. Press B with the gun in hand to choose it, then R.
- All of it is craftable and researchable, turns up in locked crates, and is on the black market.
- Hold R with a gun out for the ammo menu: it shows every round the gun takes and how many you have. Slide the mouse to one and let go to load it. (A tap of R still just reloads; B still cycles.)
- Thermal Goggles (eye slot, N to switch on): the world goes cold and dark and anything warm within 50 m glows through walls and rock - scientists, animals, turrets, fires, gunships.
- Tracking Headset (eye slot, always on): a red box on every hostile within 100 m with what it is, what it is doing (idle, wandering, defending, responding, shooting) and the range.
